en.headline: Police arrest six over Fun Coffee cryptocurrency investment scam
en.dek: A joint operation with Macau police netted five women and one man aged 51 to 64; authorities have received 225 reports involving suspected losses of about HK$94 million.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested six people on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud in connection with the Fun Coffee cryptocurrency investment scheme, which is linked to reported losses of around HK$94 million.

The five women and one man, aged between 51 and 64, were detained during a joint operation with Macau Judiciary Police conducted from 1 to 3 August. Those arrested in Hong Kong include company directors, shareholders and key members involved in promoting the project and recruiting investors. Macau police separately arrested two women on suspicion of aggravated fraud in related cases.

As of 3 August, Hong Kong authorities had received 225 reports from victims aged 32 to 83. Police said reports began in July after people said they had joined the scheme, marketed as Fun Coffee GCM Projects, late last year. The company claimed to focus on high-tech coffee equipment and gene optimisation, offering tiered returns paid in cryptocurrency, including annualised rates exceeding 200 per cent on the highest tier.

The Securities and Futures Commission had earlier placed the project on its alert list of suspicious investment products. Police said the syndicate held seminars and social events to recruit participants and encouraged them to bring in friends and relatives for additional rewards.

zh.headline: 警拘六人涉「Fun Coffee」加密貨幣投資騙案
zh.dek: 與澳門警方聯合行動拘捕五女一男，年齡介乎51至64歲；本港接獲225宗舉報，涉款約9,400萬元。
body: 警方拘捕六人，涉嫌串謀詐騙，與「Fun Coffee」加密貨幣投資計劃有關，涉款約9,400萬元。
五女一男，年齡介乎51至64歲，于8月1日至3日與澳門司法警察局聯合行動中被捕。本港被捕者包括公司董事、股東及負責推廣及招募投資者的主要成員。澳門警方另拘捕兩名女子，涉嫌加重欺詐。
截至8月3日，本港接獲225宗舉報，受害人年齡介乎32至83歲。警方表示，7月起接獲市民報稱去年底加入名為Fun Coffee GCM Projects的計劃。該公司聲稱專注高科技咖啡設備及基因優化技術，以分層回報結構吸引投資，最高層聲稱年化回報逾兩成。
證監會較早前已將該項目列入可疑投資產品警示名單。警方指集團透過投資研討會及社交活動招募參加者，並鼓勵介紹親友以換取額外獎勵。
